decisions.reason: A reference-class electrometer sits at the core of the firm's decades of dosimetry and accredited calibration expertise, so management can fully interpret its market results and keep improving it, and its home-page prominence signals strategic importance.

Oncology risk-management software builds on the firm's QA software integration capabilities and its strategy of converging machine and patient QA, so the firm has enough related knowledge to assimilate early feedback and refine it rather than abandon it after one year.
